author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at gameplay from Void Reaver and your objectives in this trailer for the upcoming game where inventory management meets bullet heaven. In this sci-fi roguelite, your backpack determines your fate. Master the art of item layout to create game-breaking synergies and turn a humble arsenal into a screen-clearing storm of destruction. Collect 300+ items and annihilate the Void. Void Reaver will be available in Early Access on PC in 2026. An updated demo is out now on Steam.
title: Void Reaver - Official Demo Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Offline Solo Mode Launch Trailer for SpaceCraft, a sci-fi open-world space exploration game developed by Shiro Games. Players will traverse the cosmos alone in a whole new mode that allows players to craft resources, build ships, and mine planets in complete solitude. Offline Solo Mode is available now in SpaceCraft for PC (Steam).
title: SpaceCraft - Official Offline Solo Mode Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Kaido Genkai, an open-world anime racing game developed by Karoshi Electric Company. Players will explore the Japanese countryside to win races, take on other rivals on the street, and customize vehicles along the way. Kaido Genkai is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Kaido Genkai - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Hilda and see the character in action in this Duet Night Abyss trailer for the fantasy adventure action RPG. Hilda is a DPS Pyro character who acts as Flora's personal bodyguard. Her calm appearance hides her formidable combat abilities, and she is sure to mix things up for players who choose to take her into battle. Her fiery temperament is exemplified by her choice of weapon, Firearm Frest, a huge grenade launcher that is sure to grab her enemies' attention. Duet Night Abyss is available on PC and mobile. Hilda is available now.
title: Duet Night Abyss - Official Hilda Character Trailer

description: Check out the Narrative Trailer for Nightscape, a 2.5D puzzle platformer adventure game developed by Mezan Studios. Players will traverse an ancient Arabian Land where the stars have fallen to Earth itself. Utilize stellar powers, take on deadly enemies, and return the stars to the heavens. Nightscape is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Nightscape - Official Narrative Trailer

description: Don't miss the Character Overview for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the hit turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Announcement Trailer for Guns of Eschaton, an upcoming soulslike first-person Western shooter developed by Eschatology Entertainment and from the mind of the late Viktor Antonov, former art director of Half-Life 2 and Dishonored. Players will embark on a treacherous journey from the East Coast to the West Coast of an America that hangs in the balance. Manage resources, take on difficult bosses with an arsenal of weapons, and master gameplay mechanics from perfect parries to the nick-of-time dodges to survive. Guns of Eschaton is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

Fight as Cielo in Virtua Fighter Crossroads, coming soon.

Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1, Nintendo Switch 2, GeForce NOW, and PC via the Ubisoft Store, Steam, and the Epic Games Store.

Take up arms as a Cinderknight to rescue their daughter, take on gruesome missions, and explore a deep narrative with a wide cast of characters. Hear more from the developers of Cinder City, coming soon to PC.

title: Naraka: Bladepoint - Official New Map: Wanchu Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Meet Maxwell and learn about this pup's mission in this new Goodboy Galaxy trailer for the platformer adventure game. The new Goodboy Galaxy trailer gives us an overview of the game's features, including the new local couch co-op multiplayer mode, bonus prequel content (Chapter Zero), and a variety of fun mini-games. The trailer also takes you into its sci-fi world, showcases gameplay, and some of the characters you'll meet. 

Maxwell the dog’s homeworld is on the brink of collapse. In a desperate bid to find help, he hyperjumps into the unknown, only to find himself stranded on the edge of a hostile star system. With rescue uncertain and the way home unclear, Maxwell will need the help of every friend (and every weapon) he can find.

Will Maxwell find his way home or is he barking up the wrong tree? The odds are stacked against him, but you know what they say: you can’t keep a good dog down!

Goodboy Galaxy will be available on Nintendo Switch on October 30, 2026. It is already avail
title: Goodboy Galaxy - Official Maxwell Introduction and Gameplay Trailer

description: Check out the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Reveal Trailer for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered, a remaster of the beloved RPG developed by Bethesda. Players can take the adventure on the go with the release on Nintendo Switch 2 with new visuals, enhanced gameplay, and more to discover. The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered launches on the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 11, with the game available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for The Quantum Mechanic, a first-person action-adventure mechanic simulation game developed by Joseph DeMartini. Players will explore a solar system on the brink of oblivion as a sole mechanic. Repair alien technology, explore the cosmos, and investigate a strange anomaly in The Quantum Mechanic, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Quantum Mechanic - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: If we say the wrong words... WE DIE! Watch the Cursed Companions trailer for this online co-op horror game that responds to every word the players say. Every player is cursed with a forbidden word, like "Okay" or "I think". If anyone says it, the player takes damage. Cursed Companions leaves Early Access and version 1.0 will be available on Steam on July 9, 2026.
title: Cursed Companions - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at gameplay and more from Pass The Fear in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite bullet-hell game. Pass The Fear will be available on PC (via Steam) on July 23, 2026. A demo is out now.

Pass The Fear is the roguelite bullet-hell shooter where you must find a way to escape before dawn breaks. Unleash the wildest projectile patterns and screen-shattering damage to crush every enemy standing in your way!

When a catastrophic Witch's Disaster strikes without warning, chaotic magic sends vast, towering waves and raging tempests to encircle your island.

Nothing gets in. Nothing gets out.
title: Pass The Fear - Official Release Date Trailer

The Career Update for Seafarer: The Ship Sim is available now in Early Access for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

description:
Take a look at the opening cinematic for Echoes of Aincrad, an upcoming action RPG set in the Sword Art Online universe. Echoes of Aincrad will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on July 10, 2026. A demo is out now.

Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. Create your hero, choose your gear, and master combat by building synergy with your partner, leveling up, and unlocking special abilities to expand your horizons in Echoes of Aincrad.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this all new gameplay trailer for Turok Origins, the return of the legendary dino hunting series being developed by Sabre Interactive! 

Battle Dinosaurs alone, or as part of a team as you uncover an alien threat, hellbent on destroying all human life in the galaxy. Wield a vast arsenal of powerful weapons, and utilise the DNA of your fallen enemies to augment your own skills! 

Turok Origins is releasing Fall 2026 to PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S.

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Terra Invicta trailer to see what to expect with the Dark Skies DLC, which brings two new scenarios to the sci-fi grand strategy game. The new scenarios provide vastly different challenges to players. In one scenario, the game begins 100 years after a nuclear war ravaged the Earth. The other is set 20 years prior to the arrival of the main alien fleet, where players have to marshal the world to fight an enemy no one yet believes exists. The Dark Skies DLC for Terra Invicta will be available on Xbox on PC, Epic Games Store, GOG, and Steam on July 27, 2026.
title: Terra Invicta: Dark Skies - Official DLC Release Date Trailer
